query: Any tips on how to tell on a doctor at the hospital who's trying to bribe me?
reference_answer:
Reporting Bribery Demands:
To report bribery demands by a government hospital staff, contact the Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Department (DVAC) or the local police station. You can also call the toll-free helpline 1064 or file a complaint online on the TN Government website.
answer: Without specific signs, it's difficult to tell if a doctor is trying to bribe you. Look for inconsistencies in their behavior, such as sudden changes in treatment or refusal of standard procedures. Trust your instincts and report any suspicious behavior to hospital security. [Document 1]
